output.reason: The PR [ev-d13371b1e9d8][ev-bb0d16bd892e] changes Argo CD's built-in Lua health check under resource_customizations/policy.open-cluster-management.io/Policy/health.lua. With this fix, an OCM Policy whose placement matches no cluster is reported Healthy instead of Progressing [ev-bd6e10b0ebe4][ev-21ed50cd7373]. behavior-changed is the right change type. The gvk subject is wrong: Argo CD does not serve this API, and nothing in the evidence gives the version 'v1' (the health check is keyed only by group and kind). So I recast the subject as Argo CD's interaction with Open Cluster Management.

correction.statement: Argo CD's built-in health check for Open Cluster Management Policy resources (policy.open-cluster-management.io/Policy) now reports Healthy instead of staying Progressing when the policy's placement matches no clusters.
